title: APPLOCKER ON DOMAIN CONTROLLERS
subtitle: WINDOWS SERVER 2025 CORE
AARONLOCKER BASELINE
AUDIT + ENFORCE GPOs
ONE ENABLED LINK
NO INTERNET NEEDED
description: A management computer holds the repository with AaronLocker and AccessChk, builds the AppLocker baseline on a reference domain controller over WinRM, and publishes an Audit GPO and an Enforce GPO that are both linked to the Domain Controllers OU with exactly one link enabled. The domain controllers apply the active GPO and the Application Identity service enforces the rules for code started in a user's context, while SYSTEM, elevated administrators and services are not restricted. The lower panel shows the methodology from Audit to Enforce and the DISA STIG outcome for WN25-00-000080 / V-277992.
